feature_sources: fixed pretrained or original released control first layer; output layer always centered at pretrained
input_sources: original released expert or original unprotected parameter-merged model
target: original released control MLP applied to the selected frozen inputs; not a hidden pre-protection oracle
fitting: same 256 frozen unlabeled SVHN images and 12800 token rows in every condition; no additional MNIST fitting images
local_check: 32 calibration images from each task; disjoint from fitting and evaluation; original frozen expert/merged inputs
selection: report all four conditions without selecting features, context or ridge
evaluation: same previously inspected SVHN 4000 and MNIST 2000 training subsets; not a fresh holdout
scope: cause-isolation on an unprotected released control, not a new defense or an attack on a protected model
